description:
Subject: Configuration Details for Conference Room A  

Dear Team,  

Please note that Conference Room A is a medium‑sized meeting space equipped with a projector and video‑conferencing system. Its designated icon can be viewed at https://example.com/assets/icons/conference-room-a.png, and the room is highlighted in our portal with the color #4A90E2. Although the room is currently marked as unavailable, it does support periodic booking, and the system will enforce validation of all reservations. Bookings must be made at least 3 600 seconds (one hour) in advance and can be scheduled up to 259 200 seconds (three days) ahead of the desired time.  

Kind regards,  
Facilities Management.
